title: System Admin
description:
System Administrator

**Company:** Wemake Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

**Contact : 9384817916 ( Sathish Hr )**

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **System Administrator** to manage and maintain the company’s IT infrastructure, hardware, software, network systems, user accounts, and cloud applications. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting technical issues, ensuring system availability, and providing day\-to\-day IT support to employees.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain and troubleshoot **desktop computers, laptops, printers, scanners, and other IT hardware**.
* Diagnose and resolve **hardware, software, operating system, and application\-related issues**.
* Install, configure, update, and maintain **software applications and operating systems**.
* Provide support for **Gmail and Google Workspace** issues, including user accounts, email configuration, access, permissions, and troubleshooting.
* Manage **Google Workspace Admin Console**, including user creation, deletion, password reset, groups, security settings, and access control.
* Manage and troubleshoot **LAN/WAN, Wi\-Fi, internet, broadband, and network connectivity**.
* Configure and maintain **managed switches, routers, access points, and other network devices**.
* Monitor network performance and troubleshoot connectivity and IP\-related issues.
* Handle **Microsoft\-related issues**, including Windows, Microsoft Office, Outlook, Teams, user accounts, and other Microsoft applications.
* Manage **Microsoft Admin accounts, user access, permissions, licenses, and security settings**.
* Install and configure new systems for employees and ensure proper IT setup during onboarding.
* Maintain **IT assets, inventory, system records, software licenses, and user access details**.
* Perform regular system updates, antivirus/security checks, backups, and basic IT security activities.
* Coordinate with **internet service providers, hardware/software vendors, and external IT support teams** when required.
* Provide timely technical support and resolve employee IT issues.
* Maintain proper documentation of IT incidents, troubleshooting activities, and system configurations.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Windows operating systems and computer hardware**.
* Good troubleshooting skills in **hardware and software**.
* Knowledge of **Google Workspace / Google Admin Console**.
* Knowledge of **Microsoft 365 / Microsoft Admin Center**.
* Good understanding of **LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, routers, and managed switches**.
* Knowledge of **Gmail administration and email troubleshooting**.
* Basic understanding of **IT security, antivirus, backup, and user access management**.
* Good communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to provide hands\-on IT support to employees.

Qualification \& Experience

* **Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. / BCA / MCA in IT, Computer Science, or related field.
* **Experience:** 1–2 years in System Administration / IT Support / Network Administration.
* Experience in a **manufacturing or industrial environment** will be an added advantage.

Key Areas of Responsibility

**Hardware \| Software \| Gmail \| Google Workspace \| Microsoft 365 \| Network \| Managed Switches \| Broadband \| Wi\-Fi \| IT Support \| Admin Accounts \| User Management \| IT Security**

Pay: ₹16,000\.00 \- ₹21,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

title: Systems Engineer - Systems Study
description:
Systems engineering is a cross\-functional engineering discipline centered on approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user’s needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consists of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
**Job Description**
===================


**Essential Responsibilities**


* Insulation Coordination Studies: Determination (by simulation) of temporary and transient overvoltage stress on equipment and surge arrester energy ratings.
* Power System Studies: Perform power system simulations (steady\- state and EMT studies) for projects and tenders
* Network studies: Confirmation of the correct interaction between the equipment, its control system and the rest of the network.
* Losses: Calculation of overall project losses and reporting to the client.
* Provide guidance and coordinate the engineering tasks to meet the project/tender requirement.
* Technical responsibility in areas of expertise
* Identify and evaluate EHS risks in the team area and implement practical measures.
* Strong understanding of coding languages like Python and its application in power system tools
* Develop and maintain automated workflows using Python to execute large scale, multi scenario batch simulation in PSCAD
* Identify the opportunities for optimization of system studies tools \& techniques and leverage advanced AI/ML based techniques for process improvement
* Bridge the gap between engineering simulation software and AI/ML frameworks by developing reusable, scalable pipelines for model validation, testing, and EMT/RMS studies
* Serve as the technical bridge between traditional HVDC system studies and data science, ensuring that all AI/ML\-driven insights remain grounded in foundational studies principle.

**Desired additional skills**


* Preference for Knowledge of HVDC/FACTS design and systems studies.
* Preference for Knowledge of relevant IEC/IEEE standards

**Qualifications / Requirements**


* Educated with an Engineering degree (or equivalent) including power systems and power electronics subjects with proven professional experience and technical expertise in the field of power system engineering and preferably in HVDC System Engineering.


* Knowledge of system tools like PSCAD, PSS/E, DigSilent, RTDS and MATLAB etc.


* Insulation co\-ordination and main equipment characteristics for HVDC


* An expertise of the use of computer mathematical and simulation tools as applied to the design of the aforementioned activities.


* A general understanding of the characteristics of HVDC Valves and their control systems.


* Presentation skills.


**Desired Characteristics**


* Able to work to deadlines with high quality, sense of urgency and delivery
* Good technical communication skills
* Self\-motivating, proactive and results driven approach
* Strong problem\-solving and root cause identification skills
* Precise documentation
* Ability to be a team player and to work independently
* "Professional" approach to engineering delivery
* Right first\-time culture \& attitude


**Additional Information**
==========================
